subject: Server CPU spikes after patch deployment
description: Production servers are hitting sustained high CPU usage after the latest security patch rollout.
resolution: Rolled back the patch on affected nodes and rescheduled rollout after capacity review.

subject: Application login page returns 500
description: Users cannot sign in and receive a 500 error on the authentication page.
resolution: Restarted the auth service and cleared the stale session cache.

subject: Suspicious MFA prompts detected
description: Multiple users report unexpected MFA prompts after failed login attempts from foreign IP addresses.
resolution: Blocked the source IPs, reset impacted credentials, and reviewed conditional access rules.

subject: Database replication lag increasing
description: The read replica is lagging behind the primary by several minutes during peak load.
resolution: Rebalanced long-running queries and increased replica throughput.

subject: Shared storage volume nearly full
description: The file share volume is above 95 percent capacity and new uploads are failing.
resolution: Archived stale data and expanded the volume capacity.

subject: VPN connections intermittently dropping
description: Remote users lose VPN connectivity every few minutes, especially during large transfers.
resolution: Adjusted tunnel keepalive settings and verified the WAN path stability.

subject: New employee cannot access payroll system
description: Access request is pending and the user cannot see the payroll application after onboarding.
resolution: Approved the role-based access package and synced group membership.

subject: Disk failure alert on backup server
description: Hardware monitoring reports failed disks on the backup appliance and degraded performance.
resolution: Replaced the failing drives and rebuilt the backup array.

subject: API service timeout during checkout
description: The order service times out when calling the payment API and blocks checkout.
resolution: Increased API timeout limits and fixed the failing downstream dependency.

subject: Privilege escalation attempt flagged
description: Security monitoring detected repeated attempts to elevate access privileges without approval.
resolution: Investigated the account activity, revoked the token, and opened a security case.

subject: Database backup job failed overnight
description: The nightly backup task failed because the target path was unavailable during the run window.
resolution: Fixed the storage mount and reran the backup successfully.

subject: File share permissions missing for finance team
description: Users in finance cannot open the shared drive because the ACL is missing the group entry.
resolution: Restored the finance group permissions and validated access with a test user.
